name: Scientific Corpus Search
description: Provision and search a sampled, provenance-aware arXiv metadata corpus with SQLite FTS5/BM25.
capabilities: search scientific paper metadata by topic, category and date
search papers with quoted phrases, exclusions, alternatives and field prefixes
look up an exact arXiv record with its abstract and links
resolve a subject named in plain language to its arXiv category identifier
report the local corpus coverage, freshness and record counts

profileId.description: Packaged bulk-snapshot sampling profile to provision.

categories.description: Optional arXiv topics that replace the profile's default topic selection.
